messages:
alex_support: Customer acct `acct_0x9a` opened a ticket — free-trial balance went from 75,000 -> 0 overnight. They swear they only kicked off a small nightly ingest. Can we triage?
helena_support: case #CS-5481 created, forwarded customer's request + timeline. sending logs and customer job id: `doc-ingest-472`. adding billing and infra. :eyes:
sasha_billing: I'm pulling the ledger now. Quick note: free trial cap for this plan is 75k credits. If ledger shows more, we'll escalate refund.
retry-bot: job doc-ingest-472 re-enqueued (worker-3) attempt=1
alex_support: customer attached their own run history — they only called our ingest once. They say our SDK should be idempotent.
maria_eng: grabbing internal logs for `doc-ingest-472` now. posted a trimmed snippet below:```[2025-09-02T02:12:03Z] worker-3 ERROR submit-embed job=doc-ingest-472 status=401 Unauthorized x-request-id=rx-9f3
[2025-09-02T02:12:03Z] worker-3 INFO reenqueue job=doc-ingest-472 attempt=1
[2025-09-02T02:12:04Z] worker-3 ERROR submit-embed job=doc-ingest-472 status=401 Unauthorized attempt=2
[2025-09-02T02:12:04Z] worker-3 INFO reenqueue job=doc-ingest-472 attempt=3
... (retries continued until attempt=20)```
maria_eng: repro steps I used locally:```export KEY=rotated_key
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"test"}'```
-- response: `{"error":"Unauthorized","code":401}`
maria_eng: important note — our billing path currently increments usage when we accept a request for the embeddings endpoint, before the remote model backend returns success. That means 4xx responses from auth failures in the middle of retries still counted usage on each attempt.
patrick_sre: if that's true, retry storms + auth failures = amplified billing. We should never bill for client/credential 4xx. We need a short-term mitigation (config change) and a long term fix.
sasha_billing: ledger dump shows ~120k credits consumed by acct_0x9a between 02:10-03:40 UTC; cost pattern matches repeated embedding calls, not generation endpoints. I'll earmark an emergency refund for the free-trial balance while we investigate.
helena_support: customer expects reversal on trial balance. I'll tell them we initiated a review and refund.
maria_eng: quick mitigation idea: update retry policy to stop retrying on 401/403 and mark as permanent failure. Also change billing step to only increment on 2xx responses (or after model ack). I can PR a patch to the gateway to postpone usage increment until success.
patrick_sre: low-risk config: add rule in worker retryer: if response.status in [401,403] -> move to dead-letter queue immediately and alert. I'll own rollout.
retry-bot: job doc-ingest-472 re-enqueued 16 times between 02:12 and 02:45 UTC (detected by retryer).
sasha_billing: proposed remediation: refund 120,000 credits to acct_0x9a (restore trial to 75k + 45k promo credit back). Need support approval to issue refund.
helena_support: approved by support lead. I'll issue standard trial-restoration flow and CC billing.
maria_eng: opened GH issue rwd/gateway#428: "do not bill on auth 4xx, stop retrying auth failures". Will push a small gateway change that defers usage increment and update worker retry rule. Targeting hotfix to staging in 1h, prod in 4h after smoke tests.
sasha_billing: added temporary billing filter to ignore usage records coming from retryer service for 401/403 between 02:00-04:00 UTC while we confirm the fix. That will prevent double-counting while we roll.
patrick_sre: monitoring/alerts: added dashboard panel for embedding-failed-4xx-rate and set alert if >5/min. Also added runbook step to check service-account rotation windows.
alex_support: looping back to customer: "We're issuing a credit reversal and fixing the retry/billing behavior so it won't happen again. We'll follow up once the hotfix is live."
helena_support: customer replied: "thanks, appreciate the quick response." :relieved:
maria_eng: follow-ups: - PR link (will paste when ready) - test plan: simulate rotated key, ensure retryer does not requeue on 401 and usage not counted. - long-term: add idempotency token for background ingest jobs so duplicate deliveries are deduped at billing layer.
sasha_billing: will confirm refund processed and post refund txn id in case notes.
patrick_sre: after hotfix and monitoring in prod, we'll close the incident. tagging @oncall if anything spikes.
helena_support: marking CS-5481 as in-progress -> will update customer when refund transaction completes. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
